---
title: Compare two runs from the history side by side
labels: complexity: medium, area: web
---

After changing an argument it is hard to see what changed in the result.

## Task

Add a **Compare** action to the run history that shows two runs side by side: status, return value, fee, resources, auth and event counts, with differences highlighted.

## Acceptance criteria

- Works with keyboard and screen readers (a table with headers).
- Component tests with recorded runs.
